mapper.sql: join jiashu_xinxi js on l.id = js.laoren_id join xitong_yonghu y on js.shouji = y.shouji
mapper.select: select count(distinct js.laoren_id) from jiashu_xinxi js join xitong_yonghu y on js.shouji = y.shouji join laoren_xinxi l on js.laoren_id = l.id where y.id = #{yonghuId} and l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除'

select count(distinct js.laoren_id) from jiashu_xinxi js join xitong_yonghu y on js.shouji = y.shouji join laoren_xinxi l on js.laoren_id = l.id where y.id = #{yonghuId} and l.ruzhu_zhuangtai in ('在住', '外出')

select count(1) from huli_jilu hj join jiashu_xinxi js on hj.laoren_id = js.laoren_id join xitong_yonghu y on js.shouji = y.shouji where y.id = #{yonghuId} and hj.zhuangtai != '取消' and hj.huli_shijian >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day)

select count(1) from jiankang_jiance jj join jiashu_xinxi js on jj.laoren_id = js.laoren_id join xitong_yonghu y on js.shouji = y.shouji where y.id = #{yonghuId} and jj.jiance_shijian >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day)

select count(1) from waichu_shenqing ws join jiashu_xinxi js on ws.laoren_id = js.laoren_id join xitong_yonghu y on js.shouji = y.shouji where y.id = #{yonghuId} and ws.shenpi_zhuangtai = '待审批' and coalesce(ws.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'

select count(1) from tuizhu_shenqing ts join jiashu_xinxi js on ts.laoren_id = js.laoren_id join xitong_yonghu y on js.shouji = y.shouji where y.id = #{yonghuId} and ts.shenpi_zhuangtai = '待审批' and coalesce(ts.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'

select js.id, js.laoren_id as laorenId, js.xingming, js.guanxi, js.shouji from jiashu_xinxi js join xitong_yonghu y on js.shouji = y.shouji where y.id = #{yonghuId} and js.laoren_id = #{laorenId} order by js.shi_moren desc, js.id desc limit 1

select l.id as laorenId, l.laoren_bianhao as laorenBianhao, l.xingming as laorenXingming, l.touxiang, l.xingbie, l.nianling, l.laoren_leixing as laorenLeixing, l.ruzhu_zhuangtai as ruzhuZhuangtai, l.lianxi_dianhua as lianxiDianhua, l.jiating_zhuzhi as jiatingZhuzhi, l.beizhu, js.id as jiashuId, js.xingming as jiashuXingming, js.guanxi, js.shouji as jiashuShouji, js.dizhi as jiashuDizhi, js.shi_moren as shiMoren from laoren_xinxi l
where y.id = #{yonghuId} and l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' order by js.shi_moren desc, l.id desc

select sq.id, sq.laoren_id as laorenId, sq.jiashu_id as jiashuId, sq.jiashu_xingming as jiashuXingming, sq.laoren_xingming as laorenXingming, sq.yuan_lianxi_dianhua as yuanLianxiDianhua, sq.xin_lianxi_dianhua as xinLianxiDianhua, sq.yuan_jiating_zhuzhi as yuanJiatingZhuzhi, sq.xin_jiating_zhuzhi as xinJiatingZhuzhi, sq.yuan_touxiang as yuanTouxiang, sq.xin_touxiang as xinTouxiang, sq.yuan_beizhu as yuanBeizhu, sq.xin_beizhu as xinBeizhu, sq.xiugai_shuoming as xiugaiShuoming, sq.shenqing_zhuangtai as shenqingZhuangtai, sq.shenhe_ren_xingming as shenheRenXingming, sq.shenhe_shijian as shenheShijian, sq.shenhe_yijian as shenheYijian, sq.chuangjian_shijian as chuangjianShijian from laoren_xinxi_xiugai_shenqing sq join jiashu_xinxi js on sq.jiashu_id = js.id join xitong_yonghu y on js.shouji = y.shouji where y.id = #{yonghuId} and coalesce(sq.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常' order by sq.id desc

select l.id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, l.lianxi_dianhua as lianxiDianhua, l.jiating_zhuzhi as jiatingZhuzhi, l.touxiang, l.beizhu, js.id as jiashuId, js.xingming as jiashuXingming from laoren_xinxi l
where y.id = #{yonghuId} and l.id = #{laorenId} and l.ruzhu_zhuangtai != '已删除' order by js.shi_moren desc, js.id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into laoren_xinxi_xiugai_shenqing ( laoren_id, jiashu_id, jiashu_xingming, laoren_xingming, yuan_lianxi_dianhua, xin_lianxi_dianhua, yuan_jiating_zhuzhi, xin_jiating_zhuzhi, yuan_touxiang, xin_touxiang, yuan_beizhu, xin_beizhu, xiugai_shuoming, shenqing_zhuangtai ) values ( #{laorenId}, #{jiashuId}, #{jiashuXingming}, #{laorenXingming}, #{yuanLianxiDianhua}, #{xinLianxiDianhua}, #{yuanJiatingZhuzhi}, #{xinJiatingZhuzhi}, #{yuanTouxiang}, #{xinTouxiang}, #{yuanBeizhu}, #{xinBeizhu}, #{xiugaiShuoming}, '待审核' )
mapper.select:
select hj.id, hj.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, hr.xingming as huliRenyuanXingming, hx.xiangmu_mingcheng as xiangmuMingcheng, hj.huli_shijian as huliShijian, hj.huli_shuliang as huliShuliang, hj.huli_neirong as huliNeirong, hj.laoren_fankui as laorenFankui, hj.zhuangtai from huli_jilu hj join laoren_xinxi l on hj.laoren_id = l.id
join huli_renyuan hr on hj.huli_renyuan_id = hr.id join huli_xiangmu hx on hj.xiangmu_id = hx.id where y.id = #{yonghuId} and hj.zhuangtai != '取消'
and l.id = #{laorenId}
order by hj.huli_shijian desc, hj.id desc

select fz.id, fz.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, fz.zhangdan_yuefen as zhangdanYuefen, fz.chuangwei_fei as chuangweiFei, fz.huli_fei as huliFei, fz.yaopin_fei as yaopinFei, fz.qita_fei as qitaFei, fz.zongjine, coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0) as yijiaoJine, greatest(coalesce(fz.zongjine, 0) - coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0), 0) as weiJiaoJine, case when fz.zhuangtai = '已取消' then '已取消' when coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0) = 0 then '待缴费' when coalesce(jf.yijiao_jine, 0) >= coalesce(fz.zongjine, 0) then '已结清' else '部分缴费' end as zhuangtai, fz.shengcheng_shijian as shengchengShijian, fz.beizhu from feiyong_zhangdan fz join laoren_xinxi l on fz.laoren_id = l.id
left join ( select zhangdan_id, sum(jiaofei_jine) as yijiao_jine from jiaofei_jilu group by zhangdan_id ) jf on fz.id = jf.zhangdan_id where y.id = #{yonghuId} and fz.zhuangtai != '已取消'
and l.id = #{laorenId}
order by fz.zhangdan_yuefen desc, fz.id desc

select jf.id, jf.zhangdan_id as zhangdanId, jf.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, fz.zhangdan_yuefen as zhangdanYuefen, jf.jiaofei_jine as jiaofeiJine, jf.jiaofei_fangshi as jiaofeiFangshi, jf.jiaofei_shijian as jiaofeiShijian, jf.beizhu from jiaofei_jilu jf join feiyong_zhangdan fz on jf.zhangdan_id = fz.id join laoren_xinxi l on jf.laoren_id = l.id
where y.id = #{yonghuId} and fz.zhuangtai != '已取消'
and l.id = #{laorenId}
order by jf.jiaofei_shijian desc, jf.id desc

select ws.id, ws.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, ws.waichu_shiyou as waichuShiyou, ws.waichu_shijian as waichuShijian, ws.yuji_huiyuan_shijian as yujiHuiyuanShijian, ws.shiji_huiyuan_shijian as shijiHuiyuanShijian, ws.peitong_ren as peitongRen, ws.peitong_dianhua as peitongDianhua, ws.shenqing_ren_id as shenqingRenId, coalesce(ws.shenqing_ren_leixing, '历史数据') as shenqingRenLeixing, coalesce(ws.shenqing_ren_xingming, '') as shenqingRenXingming, ws.shenpi_zhuangtai as shenpiZhuangtai, ws.shenpi_yijian as shenpiYijian from waichu_shenqing ws join laoren_xinxi l on ws.laoren_id = l.id
where y.id = #{yonghuId} and ws.shenqing_ren_leixing = '家属' and ws.shenqing_ren_id = js.id and coalesce(ws.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
and l.id = #{laorenId}
order by ws.waichu_shijian desc, ws.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into waichu_shenqing ( laoren_id, huli_renyuan_id, waichu_shiyou, waichu_shijian, yuji_huiyuan_shijian, peitong_ren, peitong_dianhua, shenqing_ren_id, shenqing_ren_leixing, shenqing_ren_xingming, shenpi_zhuangtai ) values ( #{laorenId}, null, #{waichuShiyou}, coalesce(#{waichuShijian}, now()), #{yujiHuiyuanShijian}, #{peitongRen}, #{peitongDianhua}, #{shenqingRenId}, #{shenqingRenLeixing}, #{shenqingRenXingming}, '待审批' )
mapper.select:
select ts.id, ts.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, ts.tuizhu_leixing as tuizhuLeixing, ts.tuizhu_yuanyin as tuizhuYuanyin, ts.tuizhu_shijian as tuizhuShijian, ts.shenqing_ren_id as shenqingRenId, coalesce(ts.shenqing_ren_leixing, '历史数据') as shenqingRenLeixing, coalesce(ts.shenqing_ren_xingming, '') as shenqingRenXingming, ts.shenpi_zhuangtai as shenpiZhuangtai, ts.shenpi_yijian as shenpiYijian from tuizhu_shenqing ts join laoren_xinxi l on ts.laoren_id = l.id
where y.id = #{yonghuId} and ts.shenqing_ren_leixing = '家属' and ts.shenqing_ren_id = js.id and coalesce(ts.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
and l.id = #{laorenId}
order by ts.tuizhu_shijian desc, ts.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into tuizhu_shenqing ( laoren_id, huli_renyuan_id, tuizhu_leixing, tuizhu_yuanyin, tuizhu_shijian, shenqing_ren_id, shenqing_ren_leixing, shenqing_ren_xingming, shenpi_zhuangtai ) values ( #{laorenId}, null, coalesce(#{tuizhuLeixing}, '正常退住'), #{tuizhuYuanyin}, #{tuizhuShijian}, #{shenqingRenId}, #{shenqingRenLeixing}, #{shenqingRenXingming}, '待审批' )
